column1: # A.8 (round 8b): every tool read of .githooks/pre-push, one row per read. Columns TAB-separated: kind, read, fact, case.
# kind: gate= or own= (a judged_read tag) or outside (a read declared outside judged_read, the census's marker/array class).
# fact: the sibling fact that shows a whole answer, or the reason an empty/short exit-0 answer is the safe side there.

# case: <file>:<@test title substring>, one match in tests/pre-push-<file>.bats, the case that drives the read (a silent or short shim through a real push, or, for a safe-side read, the case showing it refuses or stands down).
# The header's gate= and own= lists are GENERATED from this file (tests/pre-push-reads-header.sh); do not hand-edit them or this table's read column.

column2: the CONTENT grep of the tip
column3: the grep's own status: exit 0 is a match, so a match printing no hit line is short (refused naming the read)
column4: hook:a tip content grep that exits 0 (a match) and prints NO hit line

column2: the SYMLINK listing of the tip
column3: the tip tree's SIZE, read apart (a non-zero size for an empty listing is short)
column4: hook:a git silent on ls-tree in BOTH its shapes

column2: the SIZE of the tip's tree
column3: a digit run compared with an empty listing (size 0 is the one empty tree)
column4: hook:a git silent on ls-tree in BOTH its shapes

column2: the TYPE of the object the tip peels to

column4: hook:a tag of a BLOB passes through a real push

column2: the SYMLINK TARGET of a link at the tip
column3: the blob's SIZE, read apart (a non-zero size for an empty target is short)
column4: hook:a symlink TARGET read that answers NOTHING

column2: the SIZE of a symlink target blob
column3: a digit run compared with an empty target
column4: hook:a symlink target's SIZE read FAILING

column2: the COMMIT listing of a pushed ref
column3: the peeled type, a remote-tracking ref containing the commit, or the ancestry (an empty listing while none holds is short)
column4: hook:a commit listing that answers NOTHING (rev-list exiting 0 with no commit) on a NEW branch

column2: the REMOTE REFS containing the pushed commit
column3: safe: a non-answer keeps agreed 0, so the empty listing is judged short by the OR of this and the ancestry
column4: hook:a commit listing that answers NOTHING (rev-list exiting 0 with no commit) on a NEW branch

column2: the ANCESTRY of the pushed commit over the remote commit

column2: the PARENT COUNT of a commit

column4: hook:a parent count that answers NOTHING beside a combined listing that answers nothing

column4: hook:the ADDED LINES grep exiting 0 (a match) and printing NO line

column4: hook:the ADDED LINES grep exiting 0 (a match) and printing NO line
